Ex-servicemen who have already joined Government civil service after availing ex-servicemen benefits cannot claim ex-servicemen status again for this recruitment. || Staff of Quasi-Administrative offices/organizations (e.g., Railway Consumer Co-operative Societies, Canteens, Institutes): relaxation of 5 years or the service rendered in such organization, whichever is less. || Course Completed Act Apprentices (CCAA) applying for Level-1: age limit 33 years for UR, 36 years for OBC, and 38 years for SC/ST, plus relaxation for apprentice training undergone (maximum 3 years).
application_fee: Rs. 500 (Rs. 400 refundable to candidates who actually appear in the written exam)
